diligence_findings.reason: The 2026 annualized recast adds back approximately $220.4K of software development and $49.2K of website development, plus utilities, despite the business being a software platform requiring ongoing maintenance and feature work. These add-backs cannot be treated as financeable CFADS until their nonrecurring nature and post-close replacement costs are proven.
diligence_findings.provisional_normalized_cfads_range: Approximately $313K-$363K before taxes and debt service, using the reported EBITDA proxy and a provisional $75K-$125K owner-replacement assumption; exact value remains unverified.
diligence_findings.purchase_price_gap_implication: At the $2.2M asking price, a conservative debt-supported structure likely requires substantial seller financing, deferred consideration, earnout, and/or outside equity before fees and working capital. Seller-recast-based leverage should not be used until add-backs are verified.
